item.scanner:headline: Raises $1.5B in senior notes to finance Cornell Pump, Roper Pump acquisition
item.description:
Raises $1.5B in senior notes to finance Cornell Pump, Roper Pump acquisition

Completed a public offering of $1.5 billion in aggregate principal amount of senior notes across three tranches (5.250% due 2029, 5.450% due 2032, and 5.850% due 2037). The company intends to use the net proceeds, along with cash on hand, to finance the previously announced acquisition of the Cornell Pump and Roper Pump businesses. A special mandatory redemption clause requires the company to redeem the notes at 101% if the acquisition is not consummated by August 10, 2027, or if the agreement is terminated.

It operates through Water Infrastructure; Applied Water; Measurement and Control Solutions; and Water Solutions and Services segments.

Acquires First Carolina for 14.5340 FBNC shares + $294.94 cash/share

Agreed to acquire First Carolina Bancshares in a stock-and-cash merger. Each First Carolina share will be exchanged for 14.5340 FBNC shares plus $294.94 cash, subject to tangible common equity adjustments. item.description:

The preferred is convertible into common at $1.62/share, subject to a 19.99% cap until stockholder approval, and ranks senior to common.
